items.title: MECH-489 (SD-099) valence-gating retest with decision counted at the override tick
items.note: DRIVER-SIDE instrument repair + the owed MECH-489 valence-gating retest, authored together because the retest is the thing that needs the corrected readout and the readout cannot be validated without a run (chip-20260820-mech489-retest-driver-decision-at-override-tick). SUBSTRATE half already landed 2026-08-20 (ree-v3 775eb55): the post-override decision window now expires unconditionally. THIS entry lands the DRIVER half. DEFECT: the 910-lineage _decision_alignment read the latched agent._orienting_decision once per ENV STEP while the persistence window is denominated in E3 TICKS; select_action returns the held action at agent.py:6546 BEFORE the Component 4/5 block at 8130, so on a non-E3 tick the orienting fields retain the previous tick's values. MEASURED this session (Step 2.5a probe, 40 env steps, seed 7, ON arm): agent._orienting_last_output read non-None on 40/40 env steps against only 4/40 genuine E3 ticks. CORRECTION TO THE PRIOR DIAGNOSIS, and it matters: orienting_override_fired is read off the SAME latched object, so the 910-lineage n_overrides was ITSELF replicated -- it was never a trustworthy denominator. The autopsy's 'set once, synchronously, in the same if _do_out.override_fired: block' is true of the SUBSTRATE VARIABLE and says nothing about a driver sampling the latched LOG FIELD per env step. So 910's 206/42 = 4.90 is a ratio of two inflated numbers (decision latched over the ~5-E3-tick window ~= 50 env steps; override latched over ~1 E3 tick ~= 10 env steps), and the true override count behind 910a's reported 21 is ~2 -- which also means 910a's MIN_OVERRIDES floor of 5 was ~10x weaker than it appeared. FIX: a NON-DESTRUCTIVE SENTINEL tap on REEAgent.select_action, the same idiom as experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py (699/689d instrument repair) -- stamp a private attribute on the current DefensiveOrientingOutput before the call; it is absent after the call iff the orienting block ran and replaced the object (tick() constructs a NEW output at all three return sites, defensive_orienting.py:220/233/330, never a cached one). On a FRESH tick with override_fired the driver increments n_override_ticks and classifies agent._orienting_decision synchronously in the same block -- the decision is counted AT THE OVERRIDE TICK ONLY, yielding exactly n_override_ticks classifications. n_latched_ticks / n_fresh_orienting_ticks are emitted alongside per /queue-experiment Step 3.5 'Sample-size integrity -- latched substrate diagnostics', so the true denominator is auditable rather than inferred from len(rows). Nulling the attribute would also have been safe (verified: its only other reader, the motor-arrest block at agent.py:9239, is inside the SAME select_action call downstream of the 8196 assignment -- no other def between 5839 and 9260 -- and the probe produced bit-identical action sequences with and without the clear); the sentinel is used anyway because it needs no such proof. The tap is armed ONLY around 906b's _observational_run, so its scope matches the per-step log's and the corrected and legacy counters are directly comparable. PRE-REGISTERED READINESS ASSERTION (machine-checked as load-bearing criterion C1): sum(decision_counts) == n_override_ticks EXACTLY, not ~e3_steps_per_tick times it. The legacy per-env-step readout is recomputed on the same run as diagnostics.legacy_per_env_step_readout with realized inflation ratios, so this run MEASURES the defect rather than inheriting its magnitude from the 910 aggregates. SCOPE: valence-gating sub-claim (Components 4/5) ONLY. Trigger-alignment (Components 1-3) already stands fairly falsified per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-910_2026-08-10 and its 910a reconfirmation; its alignment/coupling numbers are still computed on the identical 906b substrate and reported for context (explicitly flagged as latched and NOT corrected, so they stay comparable to 910/910a) but are NOT pass criteria. CRITERIA: C1 above, plus C2 C_decision_alignment_non_degenerate (>=2 of the 3 decision classes non-zero -- 910's bug signature was 0 approach / 0 resume / 206 withdraw). AND over both; a vacuous pass on either forces FAIL. criteria_non_degenerate keys C1 to n_override_ticks > 0 (it would pass vacuously at 0 == 0) and C2 to the readiness floor. POWER: overrides are produced only in the observational eval, which is ~8% of a cell's steps (220 train eps x 200 steps vs the eval segments), so lengthening eval is far cheaper per additional override than adding seeds. EVAL_EPISODES raised 8 -> 48 by module-attribute swap on the reused 906b module, restored via try/finally (eval is ONE continuous multi-segment life per 906b's CONTINUITY REDESIGN, so this is a clean extension, not a semantic change), with 3 seeds. Expected ~19 genuine pooled overrides against a pre-registered floor of 10; below-floor self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, which here would itself be the finding that SD-099 fires too rarely at its shipped defaults to measure its own decision. ARMS / DV SYMMETRY (Step 3 declaration, one per arm): orienting_on is the only SCORED arm; its DV is the class histogram of the resolved decision over override ticks, whose symmetry group is (i) permutation/relabelling of the three decision classes and (ii) any common monotone rescaling of the two z-scored channels -- the manipulation is NOT invariant under either, because with the gate off the DV has EMPTY SUPPORT (no override ticks exist at all), so enabling the gate changes the DV's domain, not merely its value. orienting_off is a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE CONTROL: with use_defensive_orienting=False there is no gate, so n_override_ticks == 0 is forced by construction; per the two-dispositions rule it is scoped OUT of criterion scoring (disposition (b)) and its zero is recorded as a diagnostic rather than dressed up as a criterion it passes vacuously. It is retained because EVB-0610's dispatch contract requires a discriminative pair on >=2 matched shared seeds, and because it is the control making the ON arm's override count attributable to the gate rather than to the instrument. Readiness preconditions are ON-arm only for the same reason. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = resolved decisions per GENUINE override tick. Checked v3_exq_910_..._20260810T004433Z_v3.json and v3_exq_910a_..._20260810T213616Z_v3.json -- both record only the latched per-env-step counter (the defect), neither retained a per-step episode log, and both predate the 2026-08-20 substrate amend. Not recoverable by reanalysis; a run is required. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): MECH-489 run-keyed brake count = 0 (both prior autopsies read a code-bug/instrument confound, not a substrate ceiling). Brake does not fire. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (2.5c) -- recorded, not silently passed. Degrading and on-path: SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action) -- this run IS its validation; SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (e3_selector.py) -- arm-invariant. Corrupting entries whose substrate_paths name a file this driver imports, none on this run's DV path and all arm-invariant in a single-variable ablation: mode-governance-engagement (whole-file agent.py; its own severity_note scopes the live successor defect to the _lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py gate pattern, which this driver does not use); MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass, mel_consumer.py::relative_novelty; its severity_note scopes the risk to experiments consuming relative_novelty -- no criterion here reads any sleep/SWS/novelty quantity); contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; read by no criterion). Not treated as blocking because a whole-file agent.py listing would blanket-block every experiment -- 47 have been queued since 2026-08-10 on that same path -- so the module-level match is read as a screening flag and the disposition turns on whether the defect is on this run's DV path. Flagged here for any later autopsy. PROGRESS-INSTRUMENTATION FIX inherited from 910a: the reused 906b run_seed already emits one 'verdict:' line per cell, and 910a added a SECOND, so its 4 cells printed 8 verdict lines against a declared seeds=2 x conditions=2 = 4, driving the runner's overall_pct() past 100%. This driver prints no verdict line of its own -- confirmed 2 lines for the 1-seed x 2-arm dry-run, so 6 at full scale = declared seeds(3) x conditions(2). SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK, exit 0, ZERO warnings of any kind (ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT added with the reachability argument stated per-anchor). Three --dry-run passes, all rc=0. The dry-run is itself the first direct measurement of the defect: ON arm 60 eval steps -> n_override_ticks=1 with decision_counts sum=1 (C1 identity holds exactly) while the legacy readout on the SAME steps reported decision_counts_latched_sum=9, i.e. realized_inflation_ratio_decisions=9.0, and n_triggers_latched=9 against n_trigger_ticks=2. Fresh-tick fraction 0.18 (fresh=11, latched=49). OFF-arm control recorded 0 fresh ticks and 0 overrides as designed. z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998, no writer defect. Correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale (preconditions unmet at 60 eval steps), the same expected pattern as 910/910a's own dry-runs. Note the single resolved decision was 'approach' -- the first non-withdraw decision anywhere in this lineage; n=1, so a wiring demonstration only, NOT evidence. ON COMPLETION (for the reviewing session, not done by this queue-time entry): update the SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE second failure_record in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json from 'substrate_half_resolved_2026-08-20 ...; driver half OWED' to a full 'resolved' ONLY once this run has actually produced a bounded counter, and release EVB-0610 / EXP-0035 from blocked_substrate per /implement-substrate Step 8(d). Queued via /queue-experiment from chip-20260820-mech489-retest-driver-decision-at-override-tick.

items.title: INV-050/MECH-180 H1 leg (measurement axis): is 861e's seed-271 HIGH-arm MEL collapse an intervention-isolation defect? Reseed the measurement phase, substrate pinned to 861e's own 17befb8c
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 PORTFOLIO LEG. Routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-861e_2026-08-21 (status confirmed, Step 7c red-team CONTESTED -> Step 8 interactive gate verdict 'adopt_redteam_portfolio'; routing 'queue-experiment'; re_derive_brake.fired false; refused_requeue false; recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action 'none'). Governance cycle gov-20260821-0203, applied REE_assembly 26891ec7fa. Hypothesis-space qid inv050_mech180_861e_producer_vs_intervention_isolation (Mode A, frozen set H1+H3 count 2, H2 a labelled follow-on). Node class: complex (probe-gated) / puzzle (known rules). | WHAT 861e ESTABLISHED: the CALIB_DRAWS 5->10 instrument repair WORKED (R3 3/3, SEM adequate) and the answer moved the WRONG way -- seed 271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean MEL fell from 2.8999705e-05 (861c, ABOVE its own reference, factor 1.2146) to 2.2980323e-05 (861e, BELOW it, factor 0.8845). The 861c n=10 projection is REFUTED at its premise: the numerator moved. Seed 271 is NOT 'like seed 7' (861c already HIGH-graded 271 at n=5; seed 7 was already below-reference then). | EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE = diagnostic. This leg is instrument isolation, NOT evidence: evidence_direction is pinned non_contributory and evidence_direction_per_claim to {INV-050: unknown, MECH-180: unknown} REGARDLESS of the replicated grid, which is still computed in full and recorded under replication_readout for comparability with 861c/861e. Neither claim's status, confidence or v3_pending may move on it. Do NOT bump CALIB_DRAWS again; do NOT stamp substrate_ceiling; do NOT amend or fork MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (861d's, a different mechanism). | SUBSTRATE PIN (new, experiments/_lib/substrate_pin.py): ree_core is executed from a pinned historical commit via read-only `git archive` into a scratch dir first on sys.path; experiments/_lib, experiment_protocol and pack_writer still come from the live checkout. Proven by TWO fatal checks before any compute -- structural (ree_core.__file__ under the pin dir) and behavioural (ree_core.predictors.e3_selector.authority_spread_ratio, present at 17befb8c and absent at f810969). An unprovable pin raises and the runner classifies ERROR; there is no degraded mode. Per-cell arm_fingerprint uses repo_root=<pin dir> + substrate_scope=('ree_core/**/*.py',) so substrate_hash describes the code that ACTUALLY RAN; that scope is narrower than the default globs so every pinned cell is stamped reuse-INELIGIBLE (substrate_pinned_to_historical_commit) and must never be minted as a baseline. The pin also makes the leg immune to trunk drift between queue-time and run-time. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is seed 271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean_mel / mean_duration_factor against that cell's own mel_reference under this leg's single varied condition. Checked 861c (f810969/n=5/no-reseed/legacy-write) and 861e (17befb8c/n=10/no-reseed/legacy-write): every cell in this portfolio is a condition neither ran. NOT recoverable -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): examined and RELEASED. The literal run-keyed counter reads INV-050=7, MECH-180=5 (over threshold 2). Released on three independent grounds: (a) the skill's own 'Not braked' clause -- this is a `diagnostic` whose purpose is to discriminate WHY, not a lettered re-derive at the same granularity; (b) GOV-FANOUT-1 makes a diverse discrimination portfolio the PRESCRIBED route for a braked lineage carrying a fanout_recommendation, which is exactly what this autopsy emitted; (c) the autopsy's producer half stamped fired=false / route_to=queue-experiment and its category note says stamping ceiling 'would fire the re-derive brake and forbid the H1/H3 isolation the data now need'. Nearly all counted hits are standard/non_contributory targets counting only through the non_contributory-direction proxy the skill itself warns inverts the brake for instrument defects. | SUBSTRATE OVERLAP (Step 2.5c) -- a CORRUPTING overlap fired and is disclosed rather than waived: `contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy` (severity corrupting, status implemented_pending_validation, substrate_paths [ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py]). MEASURED from both predecessors' recorded manifests, not assumed: seed 271 -- the seed the whole discrimination rests on -- is write-address LOCKED in BOTH runs on EVERY arm (861c per_cycle_n_touched ~[1,1,1,1,2,1], 4-5/6 cycles insufficient; 861e ARM_3_HIGH_ON exactly [1,1,1,1,1,1], 6/6 insufficient, mean_sws_new_slot_diversity 0.0000), while seeds 7 and 883 rotate normally (3-14 slots) in both. Consequences, both pre-registered: (i) the lock is a CONSTANT across 861c and 861e so it cannot cause the DIFFERENCE -- H1 vs H3 stays well-posed; (ii) it is still a live corrupting condition on the decisive seed, which is why V3-EXQ-861h exists (the Step 2.5b(iv) adversarial-audit leg) -- it repeats the protocol with the already-built non-degenerate write selection ON, so the portfolio MEASURES the defect instead of inheriting it. 861f/861g deliberately keep the LEGACY argmin write path because changing it would destroy their single-variable isolation. Every cell records per_cycle_n_touched_slots + n_cycles_insufficient_touched_slots and the manifest carries a contextmemory_write_lock_audit block. Other overlaps, unchanged from 861e's own adjudication: MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (corrupting) inert -- run_sws_schema_pass gates the whole relative_novelty consumption behind use_mech122_spindle_content_selection, False here; mode-governance-engagement (corrupting) unrelated subsystem, this driver never imports salience_coordinator.py or regime_occupancy_gate; SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX / SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING / SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE / SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION / SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (degrading) noted, arm-symmetric, not blocking. | ETHICS PREFLIGHT (2.6): all-false / decision allow (V3, no self-model, no negative-valence manipulation, no human data). | Step 2.5a probe: on the PINNED tree, all 43 REEConfig.from_dims kwargs this driver passes exist (so none is silently swallowed -- reference-reeconfig-from-dims-silent-kwargs), agent constructs, mel_consumer present, sleep force_cycle returns the MEL keys. | THIS LEG = H1, measurement axis, REQUIRED. Varies EXACTLY ONE thing vs 861e: torch and numpy are reseeded with a fixed derived offset (MEAS_RESEED_OFFSET, not 0, so the measurement stream is fresh rather than a replay of the convergence stream) immediately before the measurement phase -- before the measurement env is constructed, so env construction is inside the isolated stream. The measurement-phase RNG then depends only on the seed and is INDEPENDENT of how many calibration draws preceded it. The autopsy withdrew 'same seeds isolate the calibration change' precisely because extra calib draws are extra frozen-wake steps consuming torch policy RNG via select_action before an unreseeded measurement loop (calib is train=False, so they are not extra world-model training -- but they do displace the stream). Declared side effect, recorded not hidden: the reseed also makes the measurement stream identical across arms within a seed, making C1's dose-response a strictly PAIRED design -- an improvement, but a change from 861c/861e. | IN-RUN CONTROL: after the 5x3 reseeded grid, ARM_3_HIGH_ON is re-run for all three seeds with the reseed DISABLED, same CALIB_DRAWS=10, same pinned substrate, same process, same machine (cells reset all RNG at entry, so order is irrelevant). H1 is therefore decided WITHIN the run, so a machine difference vs ree-worker-1 cannot masquerade as the effect -- and comparing that control against 861e's RECORDED value MEASURES the machine delta directly, which is the part of H3 the autopsy could not separate (both runs report machine_class linux-x86_64-py3.10-torch2.12.0+cpu, so any difference is sub-machine-class). | DECLARED NULL (pre-registered): decisive cell is seed 271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON, reseeded vs unreseeded, each scored against its OWN mel_reference (mean_duration_factor IS that ratio, so >1.0 is the autopsy's own criterion, not a threshold invented here). H1 SUPPORTED if reseeded rises above 1.0 while the unreseeded control stays below (reproducing 861e) -> the collapse was an intervention-isolation defect and the whole 861c-vs-861e comparison must be re-read. H1 NOT SUPPORTED if both sit below 1.0 -> an INFORMATIVE null that removes measurement-phase RNG displacement from the live set and hands the question to H3, then H2; it does NOT make seed 271 'like seed 7'. UNINFORMATIVE (non_contributory) if the unreseeded control does not reproduce 861e's collapse -- this box then does not reproduce 861e at all and there is no baseline to isolate against. That is a pre-registered readiness precondition (in_run_unreseeded_control_reproduces_861e_collapse), guarded at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against 861e's frozen recorded cell (factor 0.8845) using the shipped predicate -- not a post-hoc excuse. | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, rc=0): pin verified True, in-run control set and _discrimination() exercised on the DECISIVE seed (the smoke seed is DECISIVE_SEED, not SEEDS[0], so neither path's first populated execution is the multi-hour run), manifest relocated out of evidence/. validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK (3 advisory anchor-reachability warnings, of which the leg's OWN new anchor is discharged by a setup-time assert_anchor_reachable against the frozen recorded predecessor cell using THE SHIPPED PREDICATE; the two remaining names are inherited verbatim from 861e). validate_recording.py --strict OK. PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING: /governance applies the verdict.

That fills the missing cell of the 2x2 the lineage has been reasoning across: (f810969, n=5) = 861c, 271 HIGH-graded; (17befb8c, n=10) = 861e, 271 collapsed; (f810969, n=10) = THIS LEG; (17befb8c, n=5) = H2, the labelled follow-on. It (i) verifies the pin behaviourally in a way no static check can (861c recorded factor 1.2146 for this cell; landing near 861e's 0.8845 instead would mean the pin did not take or the machine dominates), and (ii) isolates the CALIB_DRAWS change ON THE OLD SUBSTRATE on ONE box, which is the contrast 861c-vs-861e was supposed to be but was not. | DECLARED NULL (pre-registered): H3 SUPPORTED if seed 271 stays HIGH-graded (factor > 1.0) at n=10 on f810969 while 861e collapsed at n=10 on 17befb8c -> the collapse is a substrate/machine delta and the 861c/861e comparison is confounded by code drift, not calibration power. H3 NOT SUPPORTED if 271 collapses here too -> the old substrate does not rescue it, and the in-run n=5 control discriminates further: n=5 reproducing 1.215 while n=10 collapses on the SAME substrate and box is a clean, machine-free demonstration that CALIB_DRAWS alone moves the readout, i.e. H1's mechanism confirmed from the other side. UNINFORMATIVE (non_contributory) if the n=5 positive control does not reproduce 861c (pre-registered readiness precondition pin_positive_control_reproduces_861c_decisive_cell, threshold PIN_CONTROL_MIN_FACTOR=1.10 set ~10 percent below 861c's recorded 1.2146 and guarded at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against that frozen cell using the shipped predicate). | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, rc=0): pin verified True, in-run control set and _discrimination() exercised on the DECISIVE seed (the smoke seed is DECISIVE_SEED, not SEEDS[0], so neither path's first populated execution is the multi-hour run), manifest relocated out of evidence/. validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK (3 advisory anchor-reachability warnings, of which the leg's OWN new anchor is discharged by a setup-time assert_anchor_reachable against the frozen recorded predecessor cell using THE SHIPPED PREDICATE; the two remaining names are inherited verbatim from 861e). validate_recording.py --strict OK. items.title: MECH-091 salient-event cycle-boundary reset, per-seed gated (successor to V3-EXQ-944)
items.note: SUCCESSOR to V3-EXQ-944 (ran 2026-08-22T03:52Z, ree-cloud-2, substrate 751fc5e33d58, 15 cells, 4303s), which self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue / non_contributory WHILE EVERY LOAD-BEARING CRITERION PASSED ON EVERY SEED. Reading 944's own arm_results: straddle_frac was 0.000 (ALIGNED) vs 0.789-1.000 (RATE_MATCHED) vs 1.000 (NO_RESET); C3 straddle delta 0.789/0.826/0.945/0.948/1.000 against a 0.50 floor; C1/C2/C3/C4 all passed:true; criteria_non_degenerate all true. The ONLY unmet item was precondition P3 (rate_match_holds) on ONE seed (42: 0.914; the other four 0.018-0.080), computed as a max OVER SEEDS -- so one seed vacated four clean, well-powered seeds. That is exactly what the /queue-experiment MULTI-ARM/MULTI-REGIME GATES rule forbids ('NEVER AND the gate whole-run', 2026-07-19, from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-785 sections 2a/8); 944 hand-rolled min/max-over-seeds aggregation instead of using experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py. ROOT CAUSE OF THE SEED-42 P3 FAILURE, diagnosed from 944's manifest with NO re-run: seed 42's mean_episode_length was 22.5 (ALIGNED) / 8.5 (RATE_MATCHED) / 7.4 (NO_RESET) against 47.4-72.0 on every other seed. RATE_MATCHED defers each suppressed reset by U{K..2K} = U{10..20} steps, which on an ~8-step episode is LONGER THAN THE WHOLE EPISODE, so re-issues were scheduled past the episode end and RATE_MATCHED executed 4/236 resets (1.7%) and collapsed onto NO_RESET. A DRIVER defect, not a substrate gap. FIXES. (1) PER-SEED GATE via precondition_gate.evaluate_arm_gate/aggregate_arm_gates, gate unit = seed; non-degeneracy is now 'any seed green', per_arm_gate is emitted at manifest top level, and interpretation.preconditions carries GREEN SEEDS ONLY (mandatory: build_experiment_indexes._compute_adjudication reads that list FLAT and ARM-BLIND and returns precondition_unmet for the WHOLE RUN on the first unmet entry, which would re-create the 944 vacating at adjudication time). (2) NEW pre-registered precondition P0 episode_admits_cycle_contrast: min-over-the-seed's-cells mean_episode_length >= 2 * e3_steps_per_tick (= 20). An episode shorter than two E3 cycles cannot express a cycle-BOUNDARY contrast and cannot host a decoupled re-issue; this is what seed 42 actually violated, and 944 had no such check so P3 caught the symptom instead. (3) In _lib/baselines/mech091_phase_reset.py: OFF-BY-ONE -- drain() runs BEFORE harness.step(), so the largest _global_step any drain sees is steps-1, never steps; 944 clamped to exactly steps, so every clamped reset was scheduled one step past the last drain that could see it and could NEVER fire, reintroducing inside the clamp the truncation the clamp existed to remove. Now clamps to steps-1. COLLIDING SLOTS -- real() only sets the idempotent _pending_phase_reset flag, so two resets on the SAME step yield ONE extra E3 tick; 944's clamp collapsed every late request onto one step and drain() fires at most one per step. Each reset now gets its own free step, and one with no slot left is DROPPED and COUNTED (n_resets_dropped_unfired / reset_execution_frac / n_resets_requested per cell). NOTE a while-drain would have been the WRONG fix: N resets on one step still yield one tick, so it would have inflated the executed COUNT while leaving the RATE unchanged -- making P3 look satisfied when it was not. (4) Sixth seed 45 for headroom (44 deliberately avoided -- documented per-seed instability on this env family, EXQ-539-540 / V3-EXQ-538a). Seed 42 is RETAINED, not dropped: excluding it post hoc having seen it fail would be the seed-shopping pre-registration exists to prevent; retained, it is scoped out by a pre-registered MEASURED precondition and its exclusion is visible in the manifest. P3's 0.35 tolerance is UNCHANGED -- the gate is SCOPED, never lowered (lowering converts a detected artifact into a citable result). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = straddle_frac per arm per seed. PARTIALLY recoverable -- 944's manifest carries it on a compatible substrate and this entire diagnosis was derived from it without a re-run, but its pre-registered rule is 'PASS iff (P1 AND P2 AND P3) AND C1 AND C2 AND C3', so re-scoring it post hoc by dropping the seed that failed P3 would be exactly the post-hoc rule change pre-registration forbids; a substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route's documented route is re-queue at adequate conditions. Checked v3_exq_944_..._20260822T035234Z_v3 (substrate_hash ad93e78bb660...) and both v3_exq_133 runs (different proxy DV, predate substrate_hash entirely and predate the 2026-08-17 wiring). RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): fires at count 2, and is RELEASED by its own clause. Recounted 2026-08-22 with the run-keyed counter: both braking targets are the EXQ-133 runs in failure_autopsy_grandfathered-r5-batch01-mixed-findings_2026-08-08, both recommended_epistemic_category precondition_unmet with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action 'none'. The named upstream substrate, substrate_queue MECH091-SALIENT-EVENT-TRIGGER-WIRING, is now status implemented (ree-v3 origin/main 6293b2395248, 2026-08-17) -- it wired the task-completion and commitment-boundary triggers that MECH-091 names. Verified live this session: phase_reset() now has 5 call sites in agent.py (5648 completion, 6544/8918/9118 commit_entry, 10026 harm) against the 1 the 2026-08-16 governance decision found, and the driver's own assert_trigger_wiring() reports {'completion': 1, 'harm': 1, 'commit_entry': 3}. GFLAG-0037's owed cheap puzzle-grade check (is the what_would_answer DV observable on phase 1, or is it absorbed by the EXQ-131 E3-output-freeze staleness artifact?) PASSES, and 944's real run is now the strongest evidence: the DV reads NOTHING from harm_eval or any EMA term -- it is a pure clock-timing readout (e3_tick flags from clock.advance() vs the steps at which phase_reset() was requested), which an output-freeze artifact in a downstream evaluator cannot reach. EXQ-131's artefact is rate-separation DISCRIMINABILITY (whether E3's OUTPUT distinguishes conditions); MECH-091 is cycle-boundary TIMING (WHEN E3 fires), measured cleanly across 944's 15 cells. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (2.5c), re-checked 2026-08-22 -- recorded, not silently passed. Two OPEN corrupting entries list ree_core/agent.py and neither is reachable here: mode-governance-engagement (defect is in cingulate/salience_coordinator.py's affinity clamp and _lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py; this run imports neither and leaves use_salience_coordinator at its REEConfig default False) and MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (author-scoped to agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass and mel_consumer.py::relative_novelty; no sleep loop here, so run_sws_schema_pass is never called). mech203-valence-pool-admissibility overlaps but carries no severity -> no action. FOUR open DEGRADING entries also overlap exercised paths and are recorded per the gate rather than blocking: SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action), SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (e3_selector.py), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (agent.py, environment/causal_grid_world.py), SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX (hippocampal/module.py, utils/config.py). None touches the clock-timing readout the DV is computed from; they could shift behaviour and hence episode lengths and event counts, which is precisely what P0/P1 measure and gate on. KNOWN LIMITATION, measured and NON-GATING: trigger coverage is 2 of 3. Summed over 944's 15 cells the ARC-028/MECH-105 hippocampal-completion release fired ZERO times (completion_signal_max 0.0 vs a 0.75 release threshold) while harm and commit_entry fired abundantly. That is the under-testing the substrate entry's own severity_note anticipated and classified degrading, not corrupting. Recorded as a diagnostic and deliberately NOT a preconditions[] entry, because the indexer's flat arm-blind read would flag the WHOLE run precondition_unmet and bury a valid two-trigger result. A completion-trigger probe is separate follow-on work. SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK (exit 0, zero warnings of any kind); validate_recording.py --strict on the dry manifest reports 1 complete, 0 always-core gaps; both the driver and the edited baseline module are ASCII-clean. --dry-run rc=0, and it is itself a DIFFERENTIAL demonstration of the fix: seed 7 went RED (P2+P3 unmet at toy 20-step scale) and seed 42 GREEN, and the run reported Status PASS / mech091_cycle_boundary_reset_confirmed with per_arm_gate.green_arms=['seed42'], red_arms=['seed7'] and interpretation.preconditions carrying only the four seed42:: entries. Under 944's whole-run AND that same data would have self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue -- which is the defect this successor exists to fix, reproduced and corrected on real data. Top-level substrate_hash hoists correctly from the per-cell arm_fingerprints; cells are stamped reuse-ineligible (shared_trained_snapshot_across_arms) by design. PROGRESS INSTRUMENTATION: the [train] ep N/M denominator is MEASURE_EPISODES=30 (episodes_per_run); warmup deliberately prints a non-matching '[warmup] seed=.. done=.. total=..' shape so the runner does not take its denominator from the per-seed warmup loop. seeds(6) x conditions(3) = 18 verdict lines at full scale; the 2-seed dry-run printed exactly 6. A PASS is a STRUCTURAL/TIMING result -- the mechanism does what it says -- NOT 'the mechanism pays off'; post_event_harm_mean is recorded but explicitly non-gating. Queued via /queue-experiment from IGW-20260822-232 (GOV-CONFIRM-1: MECH-091 lit_conf 0.82, zero experimental evidence).

items.title: INV-050/MECH-180 substrate-defect CONTROL leg (representation axis): is the decisive seed's MEL readout trustworthy at all? 861e protocol on 17befb8c with non-degenerate ContextMemory write selection ON
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 PORTFOLIO LEG. Routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-861e_2026-08-21 (status confirmed, Step 7c red-team CONTESTED -> Step 8 interactive gate verdict 'adopt_redteam_portfolio'; routing 'queue-experiment'; re_derive_brake.fired false; refused_requeue false; recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action 'none'). Hypothesis-space qid inv050_mech180_861e_producer_vs_intervention_isolation (Mode A, frozen set H1+H3 count 2, H2 a labelled follow-on). Node class: complex (probe-gated) / puzzle (known rules). | WHAT 861e ESTABLISHED: the CALIB_DRAWS 5->10 instrument repair WORKED (R3 3/3, SEM adequate) and the answer moved the WRONG way -- seed 271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean MEL fell from 2.8999705e-05 (861c, ABOVE its own reference, factor 1.2146) to 2.2980323e-05 (861e, BELOW it, factor 0.8845). The 861c n=10 projection is REFUTED at its premise: the numerator moved. Seed 271 is NOT 'like seed 7' (861c already HIGH-graded 271 at n=5; seed 7 was already below-reference then). | EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE = diagnostic. This leg is instrument isolation, NOT evidence: evidence_direction is pinned non_contributory and evidence_direction_per_claim to {INV-050: unknown, MECH-180: unknown} REGARDLESS of the replicated grid, which is still computed in full and recorded under replication_readout for comparability with 861c/861e. Neither claim's status, confidence or v3_pending may move on it. Do NOT bump CALIB_DRAWS again; do NOT stamp substrate_ceiling; do NOT amend or fork MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (861d's, a different mechanism). | SUBSTRATE PIN (new, experiments/_lib/substrate_pin.py): ree_core is executed from a pinned historical commit via read-only `git archive` into a scratch dir first on sys.path; experiments/_lib, experiment_protocol and pack_writer still come from the live checkout. Proven by TWO fatal checks before any compute -- structural (ree_core.__file__ under the pin dir) and behavioural (ree_core.predictors.e3_selector.authority_spread_ratio, present at 17befb8c and absent at f810969). An unprovable pin raises and the runner classifies ERROR; there is no degraded mode. Per-cell arm_fingerprint uses repo_root=<pin dir> + substrate_scope=('ree_core/**/*.py',) so substrate_hash describes the code that ACTUALLY RAN; that scope is narrower than the default globs so every pinned cell is stamped reuse-INELIGIBLE (substrate_pinned_to_historical_commit) and must never be minted as a baseline. The pin also makes the leg immune to trunk drift between queue-time and run-time. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is seed 271 ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean_mel / mean_duration_factor against that cell's own mel_reference under this leg's single varied condition. Checked 861c (f810969/n=5/no-reseed/legacy-write) and 861e (17befb8c/n=10/no-reseed/legacy-write): every cell in this portfolio is a condition neither ran. NOT recoverable -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): examined and RELEASED. The literal run-keyed counter reads INV-050=7, MECH-180=5 (over threshold 2). Released on three independent grounds: (a) the skill's own 'Not braked' clause -- this is a `diagnostic` whose purpose is to discriminate WHY, not a lettered re-derive at the same granularity; (b) GOV-FANOUT-1 makes a diverse discrimination portfolio the PRESCRIBED route for a braked lineage carrying a fanout_recommendation, which is exactly what this autopsy emitted; (c) the autopsy's producer half stamped fired=false / route_to=queue-experiment and its category note says stamping ceiling 'would fire the re-derive brake and forbid the H1/H3 isolation the data now need'. Nearly all counted hits are standard/non_contributory targets counting only through the non_contributory-direction proxy the skill itself warns inverts the brake for instrument defects. | SUBSTRATE OVERLAP (Step 2.5c) -- a CORRUPTING overlap fired and is disclosed rather than waived: `contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy` (severity corrupting, status implemented_pending_validation, substrate_paths [ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py]). MEASURED from both predecessors' recorded manifests, not assumed: seed 271 -- the seed the whole discrimination rests on -- is write-address LOCKED in BOTH runs on EVERY arm (861c per_cycle_n_touched ~[1,1,1,1,2,1], 4-5/6 cycles insufficient; 861e ARM_3_HIGH_ON exactly [1,1,1,1,1,1], 6/6 insufficient, mean_sws_new_slot_diversity 0.0000), while seeds 7 and 883 rotate normally (3-14 slots) in both. Consequences, both pre-registered: (i) the lock is a CONSTANT across 861c and 861e so it cannot cause the DIFFERENCE -- H1 vs H3 stays well-posed; (ii) it is still a live corrupting condition on the decisive seed, which is why V3-EXQ-861h exists (the Step 2.5b(iv) adversarial-audit leg) -- it repeats the protocol with the already-built non-degenerate write selection ON, so the portfolio MEASURES the defect instead of inheriting it. 861f/861g deliberately keep the LEGACY argmin write path because changing it would destroy their single-variable isolation. Every cell records per_cycle_n_touched_slots + n_cycles_insufficient_touched_slots and the manifest carries a contextmemory_write_lock_audit block. Other overlaps, unchanged from 861e's own adjudication: MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (corrupting) inert -- run_sws_schema_pass gates the whole relative_novelty consumption behind use_mech122_spindle_content_selection, False here; mode-governance-engagement (corrupting) unrelated subsystem, this driver never imports salience_coordinator.py or regime_occupancy_gate; SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX / SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING / SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE / SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION / SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (degrading) noted, arm-symmetric, not blocking. | ETHICS PREFLIGHT (2.6): all-false / decision allow (V3, no self-model, no negative-valence manipulation, no human data). | Step 2.5a probe: on the PINNED tree, all 43 REEConfig.from_dims kwargs this driver passes exist (so none is silently swallowed -- reference-reeconfig-from-dims-silent-kwargs), agent constructs, mel_consumer present, sleep force_cycle returns the MEL keys. | THIS LEG = CONTROL, representation axis. IT IS NOT A FOURTH FROZEN HYPOTHESIS and does not grow the qid's denominator (frozen set stays H1+H3, count 2, adopted at an interactive gate). It exists because two MANDATORY queue-experiment checks fired at queue time and neither could be discharged any other way: Step 2.5b(iv) (adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage and verdict-aliasing gaps BEFORE queuing, and add the leg that closes the worst one) and Step 2.5c (the corrupting overlap above, which BLOCKS by default). It converts 'running against a known corrupting defect' into 'measuring under the repair'. | Varies EXACTLY ONE thing vs 861e: same pinned substrate 17befb8c, same CALIB_DRAWS=10, no reseed -- with contextmemory_write_selection switched from the substrate default 'argmin' (legacy, degenerate) to 'refractory' (contextmemory_write_refractory_k=2). 'refractory' was chosen over 'usage_balancing' deliberately: V3-EXQ-943 validated BOTH (BIAS 16/16 occupied 5/5 seeds; REFRACTORY 5/5 seeds >=2, locking seeds settling at exactly k+1=3), but refractory's non-degeneracy is STRUCTURAL rather than counter-driven, so it is the smaller and more predictable perturbation to a run whose readout is a prediction error. Both knobs exist at 17befb8c and neither exists at f810969, which is why this leg pins 17befb8c and why the equivalent control cannot be run on 861c's substrate. | IN-RUN CONTROL: ARM_3_HIGH_ON re-run for all three seeds with the LEGACY argmin path, everything else held, same process and machine -- so the write-path contrast is decided WITHIN the run and the legacy cells double as a same-box replica of 861e's decisive cell. | DECLARED NULL (pre-registered): CONTROL FAILS if the refractory arm restores seed 271's HIGH grading (factor > 1.0) while the in-run legacy control reproduces the collapse -> the decisive seed's readout DEPENDS on a known CORRUPTING substrate defect, 861f/861g's H1/H3 readings are conditional on it, and a fourth hypothesis would owe registration against the qid -- which is a GOVERNANCE call this leg reports and does not make. CONTROL PASSES if seed 271's factor is materially unchanged under the repair -> the lock is not load-bearing for measured MEL, 861f/861g stand on their own, and the corrupting overlap is discharged empirically rather than by argument. UNINFORMATIVE (non_contributory) if the refractory arm does not actually reduce n_cycles_insufficient_touched_slots on seed 271 -- the repair did not engage, so nothing was controlled; that is the pre-registered readiness precondition write_repair_engaged_on_decisive_seed, whose LEGACY half is guarded at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against 861e's frozen recorded cell (6/6 insufficient cycles) using the shipped predicate. The refractory half is deliberately NOT anchored: no recorded run of that condition exists on this lineage, and a guard scored against a reference that does not exist would be theatre. | SCOPE: this leg does NOT validate or close `contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy` -- that entry's own validation is V3-EXQ-943's occupancy criterion, adjudicated separately. ORDERING: 861h is only interpretable alongside 861f/861g, so it is queued at a lower priority (56 vs 58); it does not gate them. | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, rc=0): pin verified True, in-run control set and _discrimination() exercised on the DECISIVE seed (the smoke seed is DECISIVE_SEED, not SEEDS[0], so neither path's first populated execution is the multi-hour run), manifest relocated out of evidence/. validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK (3 advisory anchor-reachability warnings, of which the leg's OWN new anchor is discharged by a setup-time assert_anchor_reachable against the frozen recorded predecessor cell using THE SHIPPED PREDICATE; the two remaining names are inherited verbatim from 861e). validate_recording.py --strict OK.
